# tricot trial data

> Harmonized data from tricot on-farm trials, one JSON file per trial, with farmer rankings, genotypes, traits, block and plot data and Plackett-Luce estimates. Archived on Zenodo, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17112491. Data layer of the AgrDataSci AI-ready documentation for tricot.

Read SKILL.md before answering, and start every question from datasets.csv. The data are read-only. Only the tricot data managers change this repository, and errors are reported as GitHub issues.

## Core files

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-data/main/SKILL.md): how to find, load and cite the trial data
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-data/main/AGENTS.md): short instructions for AI agents
- [datasets.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-data/main/datasets.csv): one row per trial, the index of the data
- [metadata/data-dictionary.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-data/main/metadata/data-dictionary.csv): definition of every field
- [metadata/tricot-trial.schema.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-data/main/metadata/tricot-trial.schema.json): JSON Schema of a trial file
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-data/main/README.md): overview, structure and citation

## Related layers

- [ai-ready-documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/ai-ready-documentation/main/SKILL.md): entry point to all layers
- [tricot-analysis-workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-analysis-workflows/main/AGENTS.md): how the team analyses these data
